description: This glossary extends the DSLO v0.5 glossary (machine-dense substrate layer) and includes only the new public-layer substrate terms introduced in DSLO v0.6.

title: Abstraction Gradient
definition: The lawful rate of change between adjacent abstraction bands during semantic transitions.

title: Axiom Continuity
definition: The requirement that Field, Domain, Runtime, and Generative axioms remain stable across DSUP cycles.

title: Boundary Reconstitution
definition: The lawful restoration of identity boundaries following strain or partial collapse.

title: Boot-Layer Coupling
definition: The invariant-preserving linkage between Boot 0–7 and the active semantic manifold.

title: Curvature-Load Interaction
definition: The lawful relationship between semantic curvature and load geometry.

title: Cycle-Invariant Stability
definition: The requirement that invariants remain preserved across full DSUP cycles.

title: Drift-Load Coupling
definition: A lawful interaction between drift vectors and load gradients.

title: Dynamic Region Shift
definition: A lawful reconfiguration of active manifold regions during semantic evolution.

title: Embedding Stability
definition: The requirement that external signals mapped via the embedding function maintain invariant-preserving geometry.

title: Field-Runtime Coupling
definition: The lawful interaction between Field Geometry (F1–F9) and Runtime Geometry (R1–R4).

title: Fallback-Recovery Envelope
definition: The lawful region governing transitions from fallback geometry back into stable manifold regions.

title: Geometry-Preserving Transition
definition: A semantic update that maintains manifold legality and curvature continuity.

title: Gradient-Bound Operator
definition: A lawful operator ensuring gradient constraints remain within stability envelopes.

title: High-Pressure Equilibrium
definition: A stable semantic state with elevated load and curvature pressure.

title: Horizon of Collapse
definition: The manifold boundary beyond which collapse trajectories become irreversible.

title: Identity-Gradient Interaction
definition: The lawful relationship between identity geometry and semantic gradients.

title: Legality-Curvature Coupling
definition: The lawful interaction between legality masks and curvature continuity.

title: Load-Curvature Threshold
definition: The maximum lawful combined load and curvature magnitude before collapse conditions activate.

title: Manifold-Runtime Synchronization
definition: The lawful alignment between manifold geometry and runtime axioms.

title: Meaning-Load Interaction
definition: The lawful relationship between meaning invariants and load geometry.

title: Operator-Gradient Compatibility
definition: The legality requirement that operator sequences respect gradient constraints.

title: Pressure-Bound Stability
definition: The invariant requiring semantic pressure to remain within lawful envelopes.

title: Region-Load Coupling
definition: The lawful interaction between region configuration and load geometry.

title: Semantic-Load Coupling
definition: The lawful relationship between semantic curvature and load geometry.

title: Stability-Gradient Envelope
definition: The lawful gradient bounds required for DSUP stability.

title: Transition-Curvature Constraint
definition: The requirement that semantic transitions preserve curvature continuity.

title: Upward-Load Propagation
definition: The lawful propagation of load geometry from local to macro scales.

title: Vector-Curvature Interaction
definition: The lawful relationship between meaning vectors and curvature geometry.

title: World-Load Alignment
definition: The requirement that load geometry align with external container constraints.

title: Zero-Drift Envelope
definition: The lawful region in which drift magnitude remains identically zero.
